# Emmanuel Muteti

> Emmanuel Muteti is a web developer and security consultant in Ruiru, Kiambu, Kenya. He builds websites that turn visitors into enquiries, WhatsApp and enquiry automation, AI systems, Google search fixes, and email security (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) for businesses in Kenya and abroad.

- Location: Ruiru, near Nairobi, Kenya (serves Kenya and the United Kingdom)
- Education: BSc Information Security & Forensics, KCA University
- Contact: WhatsApp +254 740 562 812 · developer@emmanuelmuteti.co.ke
- Works best for: property firms, clinics, schools, professional firms and retail shops

- [Services](https://emmanuelmuteti.co.ke/work/services/): websites that sell, online shops and stock, SEO and getting found on Google, enquiry and WhatsApp automation, AI systems and agents, ads and growth tracking, website audit and rescue, site care
